description: This Java class 'TenantProfileDataValidator' extends 'DataValidator' to perform validation logic for 'TenantProfile' objects within the Thingsboard platform. It includes methods for validating tenant profile data, queue configurations, and update operations, ensuring data integrity and consistency.

classes.name: TenantProfileDataValidator
classes.description: A validator class for TenantProfile objects, ensuring data correctness before persistence or update.

methods.name: validateDataImpl
methods.description: Performs detailed validation of TenantProfile data, including profile data presence, default profile constraints, and queue configuration validation.

methods.name: validateUpdate
methods.description: Validates that the tenant profile exists before allowing an update.

methods.name: validateQueueConfiguration
methods.description: Validates individual queue configuration parameters, including name, topic, poll interval, partitions, processing strategies, and batch size.
